title: DropBack: Keep the customer. Give back the difference. Powered by PayPal, Channel3, and AG Grid.
_actions: Each action is {"action": goto|click|hover|type|press|wait_for|wait|scroll_to|highlight, ...}. Targets are data-testid values from the UI; goto takes a path, type takes text, press takes a key, wait takes seconds.
_clips: A scene with "type": "clip" is a manually recorded clip (demo-video/clips/, gitignored; see demo-video/README.md). build_video.py inserts it at that position, trimmed to its duration; it has no actions. check_scenes.py warns if the file is missing, and a mock build skips it.

scenes.on_screen: Product returns cost merchants 25% of retail value.
scenes.narration: Product returns cost merchants 25% of sale price. When prices drop, customers dispute and return items to rebuy cheaper.
Maya buys the Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones for $398 with 14 days of automatic DropBack price protection via PayPal.
PayPal Sandbox authorizes and captures the order securely. Maya receives instant order confirmation with full protection.

scenes.on_screen: Day 3: Customer Portal triggers live Channel3 price check
scenes.narration: Three days later, Maya visits the Customer Portal. She clicks check market price, and Channel3 detects a $100 price drop at B&H Photo.

scenes.on_screen: Request Difference Refund — No return shipping or hassle
scenes.narration: Instead of mailing back the headphones, Maya requests a $100 price match refund under her 14-day guarantee.

scenes.on_screen: AG Grid Console: 86% Return Risk, Case Cost Comparison
scenes.narration: In the AG Grid merchant console, Maya's claim appears with live Channel3 evidence, an 86% return risk gauge, and pre-calculated return costs.

scenes.on_screen: AI Case Report: Returning costs $151.80 vs Settle $100. Saves $51.80
scenes.narration: The merchant opens the case. AI compares $151.80 in physical return shipping and open-box depreciation against a $100 difference refund, saving $51.80 in margin.

scenes.on_screen: 1-Click Settle: AI drafts note, PayPal issues partial refund
scenes.narration: With an AI-drafted resolution message ready, the merchant clicks Approve. DropBack executes a partial refund on the PayPal capture.

scenes.on_screen: Customer Portal: Refund credited to PayPal account
scenes.narration: The refund immediately reflects in Maya's PayPal account. Maya keeps her headphones, and the merchant protects their margin.

scenes.on_screen: APIMatic MCP Protocol: Validated PayPal Orders & Payments v2
scenes.narration: APIMatic context plugins eliminate LLM hallucinations with validated PayPal OpenAPI schemas, powering live MCP sandbox tool execution.
